chk_staff_hierarchy.name: chk_staff_hierarchy
chk_staff_hierarchy.value:
("staff_users"."role" = 'master' AND "staff_users"."parent_id" IS NULL)
          OR ("staff_users"."role" IN ('manager', 'store') AND "staff_users"."parent_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_customers_ownership.name: chk_customers_ownership
chk_customers_ownership.value:
("customers"."store_id" IS NULL AND "customers"."owner_staff_id" = "customers"."manager_id")
          OR ("customers"."store_id" IS NOT NULL AND "customers"."owner_staff_id" = "customers"."store_id" AND "customers"."manager_id" IS NOT NULL)

chk_messages_sender_consistency.name: chk_messages_sender_consistency
chk_messages_sender_consistency.value:
("messages"."sender_type" = 'customer' AND "messages"."sender_customer_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR ("messages"."sender_type" = 'staff' AND "messages"."sender_staff_id" IS NOT NULL)
          OR "messages"."sender_type" = 'system'
